_comment: Logical asset id -> runtime file. Written by tools/blender/kit_batch.py and by
renderer's model loader. Empty on purpose: the game renders a complete
procedural baseline, and it must keep working when this file is empty, missing,
`models` entries replace one named slot at runtime - `weapon.m4a1`,
`enemy.rifleman`, `prop.wreck` - and every entry REQUIRES slot, id, file,
license, source and author. Invariant 5 (AGENTS.md): a downloaded model with no
row in assets/licenses/ledger.csv fails `npm run licenses:audit`.
Optional fields: scale (model units -> metres), yawOffset, yOffset.
